SELECT c.id, c.goods_id, c.sku_id, c.goods_count, c.selected, c.create_time, g.shop_id, s.shop_name, g.goods_name, IFNULL(NULLIF(sku.sku_img, ''), g.goods_img) AS goods_img, sku.sku_spec_name, sku.sale_price, sku.stock_num, g.status AS goods_status, g.audit_status, sku.status AS sku_status FROM t_shopping_cart c LEFT JOIN t_goods g ON c.goods_id = g.id AND (g.isDelete = 0 OR g.isDelete IS NULL) LEFT JOIN t_goods_sku sku ON c.sku_id = sku.id AND (sku.isDelete = 0 OR sku.isDelete IS NULL) LEFT JOIN t_shop s ON g.shop_id = s.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
